MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. On which letter does the tone mark go in the syllable duì? (1 mark)
   A. d
   B. i
   C. u
   D. No letter

2. What do we call the sound at the beginning of a Mandarin syllable, such as h in hǎo? (1 mark)
   A. A final
   B. A tone
   C. An initial
   D. A stroke

3. Fill the blank: 电视在____? (Where is the television?) (1 mark)
   A. 什么
   B. 几
   C. 哪儿
   D. 谁

4. What are the three steps of good imitation? (1 mark)
   A. Copy, hide, forget
   B. Read, draw, colour
   C. Listen, repeat, compare and correct
   D. Talk, sleep, walk

5. What does 昨天 zuótiān mean? (1 mark)
   A. Morning
   B. Yesterday
   C. Today
   D. Tomorrow

6. What does 星期 xīngqī mean? (1 mark)
   A. Day
   B. Year
   C. Week
   D. Month

7. Which word is pronounced wǒmen? (1 mark)
   A. 我们
   B. 来
   C. 杯子
   D. 送

8. What does 来 (lái) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To come
   B. Cup
   C. Friend
   D. Birthday

9. What does 盘子 (pánzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Knife
   B. Birthday
   C. Gift
   D. Plate

10. What do the three words 早饭, 午饭 and 晚饭 have in common? (1 mark)
   A. They are fruits
   B. They are drinks
   C. They are names of meals
   D. They are days

11. Which Chinese word means "flat bread"? (1 mark)
   A. 水 shuǐ
   B. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   C. 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   D. 饼 bǐng

12. Which word is pronounced mǐfàn? (1 mark)
   A. 饼
   B. 米饭
   C. 香蕉
   D. 葡萄

13. What does 哭 (kū) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To cry
   B. To wash hands
   C. Hand
   D. To laugh, to smile

14. Which sentence means "The wind is very strong."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是太阳。
   B. 风很大。
   C. 今天天气很好。
   D. 太阳很大。

15. Which sentence means "This is the sun."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是太阳。
   B. 雨很大。
   C. 今天有云。
   D. 今天下雨。

16. Which sentence means "There is a bed in the bedroom."? (1 mark)
   A. 客厅里有电视。
   B. 卧室里有床。
   C. 门在左边。
   D. 沙发在哪儿?

17. Which word is pronounced fángjiān? (1 mark)
   A. 放
   B. 椅子
   C. 房间
   D. 右边

18. Which character is the number five? (1 mark)
   A. 七
   B. 三
   C. 五
   D. 九

19. Which sentence means "My friend gives me a gift."? (1 mark)
   A. 朋友送我礼物。
   B. 祝你生日快乐!
   C. 我们切蛋糕。
   D. 我的生日是三月五号。

20. What does 两 (liǎng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tooth
   B. Nose
   C. Foot
   D. Two (before a counting word)

21. Which Chinese word means "hello"? (1 mark)
   A. 再见 zàijiàn
   B. 叫 jiào
   C. 老师 lǎoshī
   D. 你好 nǐ hǎo

22. Which Chinese word means "bed"? (1 mark)
   A. 床 chuáng
   B. 下面 xiàmiàn
   C. 放 fàng
   D. 椅子 yǐzi

23. Which Chinese word means "kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. 厨房 chúfáng
   B. 里 lǐ
   C. 旁边 pángbiān
   D. 东西 dōngxi

24. Which Chinese word means "Saturday"? (1 mark)
   A. 休息 xiūxi
   B. 星期六 xīngqīliù
   C. 八 bā
   D. 六 liù

25. Which order does a sentence about the week use? (1 mark)
   A. what + when + who
   B. when + what + who
   C. who + when + what
   D. what + who + when

26. Why use recycled materials for a card? (1 mark)
   A. It is heavier
   B. It costs more
   C. It is not allowed
   D. It reduces waste

27. What does 饼 (bǐng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Flat bread
   B. Coffee
   C. Vegetables
   D. Chicken (meat)

28. Which sentence means "I like to drink tea."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喜欢喝茶。
   B. 这是香蕉。
   C. 我早饭吃饼。
   D. 我喝茶。

29. What is the last stroke written in 头? (1 mark)
   A. 横 héng
   B. 捺 nà
   C. 撇 piě
   D. 点 diǎn

30. Which Chinese word means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. 天气 tiānqì
   B. 也 yě
   C. 小 xiǎo
   D. 太阳 tàiyáng

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" and "Hello! (polite)" (4 marks)

32. Write a sentence asking when a friend's birthday is, and a sentence answering that your birthday is on 10 May. Include pinyin. (4 marks)

33. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 八 and 玩. (2 marks)

34. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 说 and 再见. (2 marks)

35. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is the sun." (2 marks)

36. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肉, 用 and 摸. (3 marks)

37. Give three ways to make a reading club work well. (3 marks)

38. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." and "The television is on the table." (4 marks)

39. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛奶, 大 and 昨天. (3 marks)

40. Add punctuation to: 我喜欢芒果香蕉葡萄你呢 (3 marks)

41. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 客厅 and 咖啡. (2 marks)

42. Explain what the part 女 tells us in 妈, 姐 and 妹. (3 marks)

43. Give two habits of an active listener. (2 marks)

44. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天 and 老师. (2 marks)

45. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒmen qiē dàngāo. (2 marks)

46. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "And you?" (2 marks)

47. Write three things you could include in a class display and one thing to check. (3 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 放 and 蜡烛. (2 marks)

49. Tell how to tell 大 dà from 太 tài by looking. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — i
   With ui the mark goes on the second vowel, i.

2. C — An initial
   The consonant sound at the start of a syllable is the initial.

3. C — 哪儿
   哪儿 asks where.

4. C — Listen, repeat, compare and correct
   Good imitation means listening carefully, repeating, then comparing with the speaker.

5. B — Yesterday
   昨天 is yesterday.

6. C — Week
   星期 followed by a number makes the day names.

7. A — 我们
   我们 is pronounced wǒmen and means we.

8. A — To come
   来 (lái) means to come.

9. D — Plate
   盘子 (pánzi) means plate.

10. C — They are names of meals
   饭 is meal, and the first characters tell the time of day.

11. D — 饼 bǐng
   饼 (bǐng) means flat bread.

12. B — 米饭
   米饭 is pronounced mǐfàn and means cooked rice.

13. A — To cry
   哭 (kū) means to cry.

14. B — 风很大。
   风很大。 (fēng hěn dà.) means "The wind is very strong.".

15. A — 这是太阳。
   这是太阳。 (zhè shì tàiyáng.) means "This is the sun.".

16. B — 卧室里有床。
   卧室里有床。 (wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.) means "There is a bed in the bedroom.".

17. C — 房间
   房间 is pronounced fángjiān and means room.

18. C — 五
   五 wǔ is five.

19. A — 朋友送我礼物。
   朋友送我礼物。 (péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.) means "My friend gives me a gift.".

20. D — Two (before a counting word)
   两 (liǎng) means two (before a counting word).

21. D — 你好 nǐ hǎo
   你好 (nǐ hǎo) means hello.

22. A — 床 chuáng
   床 (chuáng) means bed.

23. A — 厨房 chúfáng
   厨房 (chúfáng) means kitchen.

24. B — 星期六 xīngqīliù
   星期六 (xīngqīliù) means Saturday.

25. C — who + when + what
   我 + 星期三 + 去学校.

26. D — It reduces waste
   Reusing materials means less rubbish.

27. A — Flat bread
   饼 (bǐng) means flat bread.

28. A — 我喜欢喝茶。
   我喜欢喝茶。 (wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.) means "I like to drink tea.".

29. B — 捺 nà
   The order is 点, 点, 横, 撇, 捺.

30. D — 太阳 tàiyáng
   太阳 (tàiyáng) means sun.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo! 您好! nín hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? 我的生日是五月十号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì wǔ yuè shí hào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 八: bā, eight. 玩: wán, to play.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: 说: shuō, to speak. 再见: zàijiàn, goodbye.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是太阳。 zhè shì tàiyáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肉: ròu, meat. 用: yòng, to use. 摸: mō, to touch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be kind and do not laugh at mistakes, listen while others read, take turns fairly and help others who find reading hard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì. 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: 牛奶: niúnǎi, milk. 大: dà, big. 昨天: zuótiān, yesterday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢芒果、香蕉、葡萄。你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 、, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for ?.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 客厅: kètīng, living room. 咖啡: kāfēi, coffee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: 女 means woman or female, so the characters are for female family members.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the link to family, 1 mark for naming the three characters.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Face the speaker and stay quiet; listen for key words; nod or show you are following.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天: tiān, sky, day. 老师: lǎoshī, teacher.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: We cut the cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你呢? nǐ ne?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example a labelled house plan, a birthday card and character models; check tone marks and stroke order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item and 1 mark for a check.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 放: fàng, to put. 蜡烛: làzhú, candle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太 has an extra dot at the bottom right.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dot and 1 mark for naming the two characters correctly.
